title: Next.js: Cross-user cache disclosure and poisoning in Next.js use cache with binary arguments (CVE-2026-119349)
description: Next.js App Router applications using the `use cache` directive with binary arguments (e.g., Uint8Array or Blob) may generate identical cache keys for different inputs. This flaw can cause cached data to be shared across users, leading to cross-user cache disclosure or cache poisoning. The vulnerability affects Next.js versions from 16.0.0 up to but not including 16.4.5. A fix is available in version 16.4.5.
